<![CDATA[
function insert$Retrieve$Items(g, r1, z, r2, columns, c1, c2) {
  var a1 = (columns + (c1 ? ',' + c1 : '')).split(','), a2 = (columns + (c2 ? ',' + c2 : '')).split(',');
  for (var i = 0; i < a1.length; i++) {
    var l1 = g._getColumnOrder($func.trim(a1[i])), l2 = z._getColumnOrder($func.trim(a2[i]));
    if (l1 > 0 && l2 > 0) z._setItemValue(r2, l2, g._getItemValue(r1, l1));
  }
}
function check$Retrieve$Items$DefaultMemvar(g, r, type, a) {
  if (type == 1 || !a) {
    return g.blankMemvar(r);
  } else {
    var i, j;
    if (g._rowCount < r) return !0;
    for (i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {if (g._getItemValue(r, g._getColumnOrder(a[i][0])) != (a[i][2] == 1 ? parseFloat(a[i][1]) : a[i][1])) return !1;}
    for (i = 0; i < g._fields.length; i++) {
      var t = g._fields[i], k = 0;
      for (j = 0; j < a.length; j++) {if (t.Name == a[j][0]) k += 1;}
      if (k == 0) {if ((!t.ReadOnly && !t.Hidden && !t.External || t.AllowContain) && g._getItemValue(r, i + 1)) return !1;}
    }
    return !0;
  }
  return !0;
}
]]>

Name: ScriptCheckGridIrregularCode
Content:
<![CDATA[
function CheckGridIrregularCode(v) {
  var s = '\'`~!@#$%^&*(),;"<>?/\\,_', e = false;
  if (v.length > 0) {
    if (v[0] == ' ') e = true;
    else {
      for (var j = 0; j < v.length; j++) {
        if (s.indexOf(v[j]) >= 0) {
          e = true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return !e;
}
]]>

Name: ScriptEmptyExternalField

function set$Voucher$EmptyExternalField(g, s) {
  var a = s.split(',');
  for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    var l = g._getColumnOrder($func.trim(a[i]));
    for (var r = 0; r < g._rowCount; r++) {
      g._setItemValue(r + 1, l, null);
    }
  }
}
